### CVE-2020-3950
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2020-03-17 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: Privilege escalation vulnerability; CWE-269 CWE-269 Improper Privilege Management
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 48337: VMware Fusion - USB Arbitrator Setuid Privilege Escalation (Metasploit) (local/macos, 2020-04-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 48337: VMware Fusion - USB Arbitrator Setuid Privilege Escalation (Metasploit) (local/macos, 2020-04-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 48235: VMware Fusion 11.5.2 - Privilege Escalation (local/macos, 2020-03-20, verified=1)

VMware Fusion (11.x before 11.5.2), VMware Remote Console for Mac (11.x and prior before 11.0.1) and Horizon Client for Mac (5.x and prior before 5.4.0) contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries. Successful exploitation of this issue may allow attackers with normal user privileges to escalate their privileges to root on the system where Fusion, VMRC or Horizon Client is installed.

Affected:
- n/a / VMware Fusion, VMware Remote Console for Mac and Horizon Client for Mac: affected VMware Fusion (11.x before 11.5.2), VMware Remote Console for Mac (11.x and prior before 11.0.1) and Horizon Client for Mac (5.x and prior before 5.4.0)

### CVE-2020-3956
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2020-05-20 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Code Injection Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 48540: vCloud Director 9.7.0.15498291 - Remote Code Execution (remote/linux, 2020-06-02, verified=0)

VMware Cloud Director 10.0.x before 10.0.0.2, 9.7.0.x before 9.7.0.5, 9.5.0.x before 9.5.0.6, and 9.1.0.x before 9.1.0.4 do not properly handle input leading to a code injection vulnerability. An authenticated actor may be able to send malicious traffic to VMware Cloud Director which may lead to arbitrary remote code execution. This vulnerability can be exploited through the HTML5- and Flex-based UIs, the API Explorer interface and API access.

Affected:
- n/a / VMware Cloud Director: affected VMware Cloud Director 10.0.x before 10.0.0.2, 9.7.0.x before 9.7.0.5, 9.5.0.x before 9.5.0.6, and 9.1.0.x before 9.1.0.4.

### CVE-2020-5415 — Concourse's GitLab auth allows impersonation
- Assigner: pivotal | Published: 2020-08-12 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-290 CWE-290: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L`

Concourse, versions prior to 6.3.1 and 6.4.1, in installations which use the GitLab auth connector, is vulnerable to identity spoofing by way of configuring a GitLab account with the same full name as another user who is granted access to a Concourse team. GitLab groups do not have this vulnerability, so GitLab users may be moved into groups which are then configured in the Concourse team.

Affected:
- VMware Tanzu / Concourse: affected 6.4 <6.4.1 (custom); affected 6.3 <6.3.1 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/concourse/concourse/security/advisories/GHSA-627p-rr78-99rj [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- https://tanzu.vmware.com/security/cve-2020-5415 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2020-5425 — User Impersonation possible in Tanzu SSO
- Assigner: pivotal | Published: 2020-10-31 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-287 CWE-287: Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:H/A:H`

Single Sign-On for Vmware Tanzu all versions prior to 1.11.3 ,1.12.x versions prior to 1.12.4 and 1.13.x prior to 1.13.1 are vulnerable to user impersonation attack.If two users are logged in to the SSO operator dashboard at the same time, with the same username, from two different identity providers, one can acquire the token of the other and thus operate with their permissions. Note: Foundation may be vulnerable only if: 1) The system zone is set up to use a SAML identity provider 2) There are internal users that have the same username as users in the external SAML provider 3) Those duplicate-named users have the scope to access the SSO operator dashboard 4) The vulnerability doesn't appear with LDAP because of chained authentication.

Affected:
- VMware Tanzu / Single Sign-On for VMware Tanzu: affected 1.11 <1.11.3 (custom); affected 1.12 <1.12.4 (custom); affected 1.13 <1.13.1 (custom)

References:
- https://tanzu.vmware.com/security/cve-2020-5425 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2020-5426 — Scheduler for TAS can transmit privileged UAA token in plaintext
- Assigner: pivotal | Published: 2020-11-11 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 8.6
- CWE: CWE-319 CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 8.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L`

Scheduler for TAS prior to version 1.4.0 was permitting plaintext transmission of UAA client token by sending it over a non-TLS connection. This also depended on the configuration of the MySQL server which is used to cache a UAA client token used by the service. If intercepted the token can give an attacker admin level access in the cloud controller.

Affected:
- VMware Tanzu / Pivotal Scheduler: affected All <1.4.0 (custom)

References:
- https://tanzu.vmware.com/security/cve-2020-5426 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
